test_name: Issue #1566: OCCTPolyMergeNodes refuses rather than mis-reports on buffer overflow::vertex buffer too small: refuses (returns 0), does not touch outTriangleCount

data.reason: The refusal is bridge policy (#1566): OCCTPolyMergeNodes returns 0 and leaves outTriangleCount untouched (the bridge observed returned_count 0 and outTriangleCount -1) when the merged node count exceeds the caller's maxVertices. The kernel has no buffer-capacity concept, so there is no kernel value for the refusal itself. What the kernel supplies is the size the refusal is measured against, 24 merged nodes (Poly_MergeNodesTool printed nbNodes=24, against maxVertices 1), which is recorded in the generous-buffers record.

Bridge: Mesh.union(with:)(...) at deflection 0.5, then the triangle count and the volume the result mesh encloses (divergence theorem over the vertices).
